name: B10-0281/2025 (The Left) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Mali's military authorities to reverse their dissolution of all political parties and their ban on political gatherings. It says these moves break Mali's own constitution and its human rights promises. It asks the authorities to hold free and fair elections instead of extending the transition period, to stop cracking down on critics and the media, and to release people held for political reasons. It also condemns abuses by the Wagner Group and the Africa Corps, and urges debt cancellation for African countries.

- The text asks Mali's rulers to undo the party ban and hold elections; it changes no law itself.
- It concerns Mali's government, opposition, journalists and protesters.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to European Union bodies, member states and Mali's authorities.
